# Load packages

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(scDblFinder)
```



# Read in the data

```{r, include=FALSE}
B16_tumour_data <- read.delim("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_tumours/tumours_scRNAseq/GSE228014_B16F10_processed.txt")
```



# Format data

```{r}
# Make gene names rownames
B16_tumour_data$X <- as.character(B16_tumour_data$X)

B16_tumour_data <- aggregate(. ~ X, data = B16_tumour_data, FUN = sum, na.rm = TRUE)
rownames(B16_tumour_data) <- B16_tumour_data$X
B16_tumour_data <- B16_tumour_data[, -1]

B16_tumour_matrix <- data.matrix(B16_tumour_data)
B16_tumour_matrix <- as(B16_tumour_matrix, "dgCMatrix")


# Create seurat object
### NOTE - treating the normalized counts as counts just to satisfy the seurat object requirements
B16_tumour_so <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = B16_tumour_matrix,
  project = "B16F10_tumours"
)

# Put normalized matrix into the data slot
B16_tumour_so <- SetAssayData(
    object = B16_tumour_so,
    layer  = "data",
    new.data = B16_tumour_matrix,
    assay  = "RNA"
)
```

### NOTE - this data is already processed. Move directly to PCA and clustering. 


```{r, include=FALSE}
all_genes_B16_tumour <- rownames(B16_tumour_so)

B16_tumour_so_norm <- B16_tumour_so %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 4000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = all_genes_B16_tumour) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(B16_tumour_so_norm, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
B16_tumour_so_norm <- B16_tumour_so_norm %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:41) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 1.2) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:41)
```



### NOTE - skipping doublet detection because it requires raw counts. 



# Annotate cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(B16_tumour_so_norm) <- "seurat_clusters"

cluster_ids <- levels(B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
cluster_labels <- c("Malignant cells", 
                 "Malignant cells", 
                 "Malignant cells",
                 "Malignant cells",
                 "Malignant cells",
                 "5")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
cluster_to_cell_type <- setNames(cluster_labels, cluster_ids)

B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters <- cluster_labels[B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters]
```


## Order clusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters <- factor(B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters, levels = c(
            "Malignant cells", 
            "5"))
```

### DotPlot to show differentially expressed genes between clusters

```{r}
DefaultAssay(B16_tumour_so_norm) <- "RNA"
Idents(B16_tumour_so_norm) <- "seurat_clusters"

DotPlot(object = B16_tumour_so_norm, features = c(
  "Mitf", "Sox10", "Pax3", "Ednrb", # Melanocytes
  "Epcam", "Krt8", "Krt18", "Krt19", "Muc1", "Top2a", "Pcna", # Malignant cells
  "Cdh5", "Pecam1", "Igfbp3", "Igfbp7", # Endothelial cells
  "Col1a1", "Col1a2", "Serping1", "Dcn", # Cancer-associated fibroblasts
  "Cd209a", "Itgam", "Ccr2", "Ly6c2", # Monocytes
  "Cd68", "Cd74", "Cd83", "Ccl6", "Ccl9", "C1qa", # Macrophages
  "S100a8", "S100a9", "Ifitm1", # Neutrophils
  "Cd79a", # B cells
  "Il7r", "Cd4", # T cells
  "Nkg7", "Klra7", # NK cells
  "Hba-a2"
  )) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1, face = "italic")) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("red", "white", "blue")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, face = "italic"))
```


## Split cluster 5

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(B16_tumour_so_norm) <- "seurat_clusters"

cluster_5 <- subset(B16_tumour_so_norm, idents = "5")

cluster_5 <- NormalizeData(cluster_5)
cluster_5 <- FindVariableFeatures(cluster_5, nfeatures = 4000)
cluster_5 <- ScaleData(cluster_5)
cluster_5 <- RunPCA(cluster_5, npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(cluster_5, ndims = 50)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
cluster_5 <- FindNeighbors(cluster_5, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:50) %>% 
  FindClusters(resolution = 1.2)

cluster_5 <- RunUMAP(cluster_5, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:50)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(cluster_5) <- "RNA"

Idents(cluster_5) <- cluster_5$seurat_clusters
cluster_5 <- JoinLayers(cluster_5, what = "all")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(cluster_5) <- "seurat_clusters"

cluster_5_cluster_labels <- c("Monocytes/macrophages", "Endothelial cells/CAFs")

cluster_5_clusters <- cluster_5@meta.data$seurat_clusters

cluster_5$seurat_clusters <- cluster_5_cluster_labels[cluster_5$seurat_clusters]
```

### Write new cluster labels back into B16_tumour_so_norm

```{r, include=FALSE}
B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters <- as.character(B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters)

B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters[Cells(cluster_5)] <- 
  as.character(cluster_5$seurat_clusters)

B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters <- factor(B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters)
```


## Re-order clusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters <- factor(B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters, levels = c(
            "Malignant cells", 
            "Endothelial cells/CAFs",
            "Monocytes/macrophages"))
```


## Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(B16_tumour_data, B16_tumour_matrix, B16_tumour_so, cluster_5, cluster_5_cluster_labels, cluster_5_clusters, cluster_ids, cluster_labels, cluster_to_cell_type)
```


## Visualize

```{r}
B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters <- as.character(B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters)

B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters[
  B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters == "Endothelial cells/CAFs"
] <- "ECs/CAFs"

B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters <- factor(B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters)

B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters <- factor(
  B16_tumour_so_norm$seurat_clusters,
  levels = c(
    "Tumour cells",
    "ECs/CAFs",
    "Monocytes/macrophages"
  )
)



B16_cluster_colours <- c(
    "Malignant cells"       = "#C0C0C0",
    "ECs/CAFs"              = "#BFFF00",
    "Monocytes/macrophages" = "#4BB5FF"
)

DimPlot(B16_tumour_so_norm, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1, cols = B16_cluster_colours) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```
